BiblicalUsage: Naqod means speckled or spotted, and it is the word for the marked sheep in Jacob's bargain with Laban. In Genesis 30:32 Jacob will pass through the flock and remove all the speckled and spotted cattle, and the spotted and speckled among the goats, and in Genesis 30:33 his righteousness shall answer for him in time to come, when every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats shall be counted stolen.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spotted sheep are the picture of a bargain God honoured, because Jacob's wages were the marked animals and the Lord multiplied them; Laban changed the wages ten times, and the spots still belonged to Jacob.
